headline: DNI Stream
strapline: A live knowledge repository for software professionals.
intro: We aim to make development more accessible to everyone, lowering the barrier to entry with accurate information that benefits our community and the software industry.
Our shows are streamed live so we can answer your questions immediately. Every past podcast episode is here to listen to.

cards.title: Documentation Not Included
cards.text: The podcast: an hour-long dive into the world of the IT professional, from languages and frameworks to professional practices and processes.

cards.title: The DNI'ers
cards.text: Our Discord server, with IT professionals from all over the world. Come along for geeky discussion, or vent about the system that just won't do what you want.
